title: Chestnut and Irish Wrap
description: A delicious and filling wrap filled with roasted chestnuts, crispy bacon, and melted cheese.
instructions: In a bowl, toss the chestnuts with coconut oil, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the chestnuts on a baking sheet and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Cook the crispy bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy. Set aside.
Warm the wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or according to package instructions.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the roasted chestnuts, crispy bacon, and mozzarella cheese down the center.
Top with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
